text:
Anya (UX): quick review pls — SLO import flow + suppression scheduling. screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/ux/slo-import.png. three asks: microcopy for the dropdown, keyboard nav for the schedule picker, and preview behavior for overlapping suppressions.

Matt (FE): looks good overall. tiny nit: label currently 'Suppression window' — i'd vote for something more action-y like 'Mute notifications for'.

Kevin (PM): +1 to action-y. also need timezone shown prominently in the picker (users keep assuming their org TZ).

Olivia (Accessibility): keyboard nav is critical — picker should allow arrow keys to move between days, Enter to toggle, Esc to close. also the focus ring is missing in the mock. contrast on the schedule pill (light gray text on gray BG) might fail WCAG.

Diego (Eng): FYI implementation detail: we map schedule to cron-ish rules server-side. UX should avoid exposing cron. for overlapping suppressions, i'd prefer merge when same channel+periodicity; otherwise show a conflict state in preview.

Anya (UX): draft microcopy variants: 1) 'Mute notifications for' 2) 'Silence alerts for' 3) 'Temporarily suppress notifications'. which is clearest?

Kevin (PM): i like #1 for brevity. #3 feels verbose.

Matt (FE): for keyboard accessibility we'll add tabindex=0 on each pill, implement a visible outline on focus, and ensure mobile hit targets >= 44px.

Olivia (Accessibility): minor copy note — our glossary prefers the term 'alerts' for SLO triggers rather than 'notifications'. so maybe 'Mute alerts for'. also helper text must be legible (>=14px on mobile) and we should avoid color-only state indicators.

Anya (UX): ok switching to 'Mute alerts for' + helper: 'Choose duration or schedule.' will update mocks.

ai-design-bot: accessibility scan: phrase 'Mute alerts for' ok; recommended helper length <= 60 chars. flagged: missing visible focus style in mock v3.

Diego (Eng): question about preview: if import contains overlapping suppressions across channels, should preview merge timelines or list entries with a conflict badge? i prefer merge for exact duplicates, and show 'partial overlap' badge for channel-diff overlaps.

Kevin (PM): sounds good. UX should surface a quick explanation: 'Merged suppressions hide duplicate alerts; partial overlaps will show details.'

Anya (UX): example helper/code snippet i'm going to add to the mock:
```
Mute alerts for: 1h | Until 2025-02-01 | Schedule...
Helper: Choose duration or schedule. Timezone: PST
```

Matt (FE): will implement focus & keyboard behaviors; i'll also add a small timezone label under the time input.

Olivia (Accessibility): i'll run a quick a11y pass after Anya updates. also we should add aria-live region for preview updates so screenreader users know when import results change.

Diego (Eng): i'll write the merge/conflict rules in the spec doc and post a diff.

Kevin (PM): action items: Anya -> update mocks and copy; Matt -> keyboard/focus + timezone label; Diego -> merge rules; Olivia -> a11y pass. target: ship in 2-week sprint. objections?

Anya (UX): none from me, will post updated figma by EOD tomorrow and ping @Olivia for review.

Matt (FE): ack.

Diego (Eng): ack, will start the spec PR.

Olivia (Accessibility): ack, will review once figma link updated.

Kevin (PM): thanks all. :thumbsup:
